allowedLinearReferenceUses: external tracker URL for human navigation
authorityNotice: This artefact defines the repository-owned boundary for Linear references. It does not make Linear semantic authority; it prevents Linear from becoming semantic authority.
forbiddenLinearReferenceUses: owner decision that exists only in Linear
gate definition that exists only in Linear
readiness meaning that exists only in Linear
validator rule that requires Linear access
proof requirement that requires Linear access
implementation expectation that exists only in Linear
non-claim boundary that exists only in Linear
nonClaims: No legal or compliance readiness is claimed.
No staging, production, live-provider, product, release, or human-acceptance readiness is claimed.
purpose: Ensure USF semantic authority remains self-contained in repository-controlled artefacts, validators, and proof evidence even when Linear tracks work and operational history.
repositorySelfSufficiencyRules: USF semantic definitions must live in repository-controlled artefacts.
Linear issue descriptions, comments, labels, names, states, and closure events are operational tracker data only.
A repository artefact may cite a Linear issue only as traceability or action history.
Repository validators, gates, and proof logic must not call Linear to determine semantic meaning.
A distributed copy of the repository must remain semantically complete without Linear access.
If semantic knowledge is found only in Linear, it must be copied into a repository artefact or tracked as repository-authority-copy work.
title: Linear Reference Boundary and Repository Self-Sufficiency

linearFollowUpDeliveryRules.rule: Linear items discovered during repository delivery audit must be dispositioned in repository-owned artefacts. If future work remains, that work is delivered for tracking purposes by creating or linking a Linear follow-up issue, not by treating Linear text, status, comments, labels, or project fields as USF semantic authority.
linearFollowUpDeliveryRules.completionBoundary: Creating or linking a follow-up Linear issue records later work. It does not complete that follow-up work and does not satisfy that issue acceptance criteria.
linearFollowUpDeliveryRules.laterWorkTrackingBoundary: Deferred, blocked, unresolved, credential-gated, externally gated, duplicate, canceled, obsolete, and operational-only Linear work is delivered as later-work Linear issues or explicit repository-owned dispositions. These issues do not define USF semantic authority and do not make current implementation complete.
